about: Indraprastha Gas Limited distributes and sells natural gas in India. It supplies compressed natural gas (CNG) to the transport sector; and piped natural gas to domestic, industrial, and commercial sectors. The company operates CNG stations, as well as steel pipeline and MDPE networks.
